summary: Keurig Dr Pepper filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $2.0bn primary common stock offering, following its strategic separation plan into Beverage Co. and Global Coffee Co. and its acquisition of JDE Peet's. Terms are incomplete: pricing, discount and proceeds are blank, with the last sale at $38.25 on November 11, 2026. A 30-day option covers up to $300m of additional shares; Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are joint book-runners. Watch final pricing, discount and use of proceeds, plus Separation execution risk around the arbitrage.
